imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The garment-bag guide uses three accurate Amazon category text links; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Six HTTPS-homepage impressions, one HTTP-homepage impression, zero clicks, average position 1.3, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap snapshot remains stale at 26 submitted and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small for a Data-led item. The batch therefore creates one authority asset and two unrelated explorations while strengthening money, tailored-clothing travel and accessible conditioning clusters plus their crawl paths.
searchConsole.ignored: The homepage-only impressions, aggregate position and stale sitemap snapshot were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a new query-family page; they informed stronger hubs, reciprocal links, Library coverage and sitemap discovery only.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the garment-bag guide. The wage-error and jump-rope guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy wage-error evidence file that reconciles scheduled and recorded time, pay basis, additions, deductions, deposits, year-to-date figures, written corrections and distinct federal, state, tax and benefits escalation lanes.
authority.cluster: Money and work administration, with reciprocal paths from paycheck withholding, checking-account review, job-offer comparison and raise preparation; the other pages strengthen tailored-clothing travel and controlled conditioning equipment.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for the U.S. Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division and state labor-department worker-education teams; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Fitness: how to prove and route a paycheck discrepancy, how to transport tailored clothing, and how to buy and use a jump rope safely. Only the garment-bag guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
